Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP pressure, CC-immunity brake, job helpers, assists, and target clarity.
Description: A local PvP HUD integrating pressure and CC-protection cues, a default-off exact-target hard-stop CC-immunity brake with strict public-CC fallback resolution, native-HUD resource auras, Ninja Seiton decisions, warnings, fail-closed macro utilities, opt-in job helpers, and target highlights.
Changelog: Hardens the default-off CC-immunity brake when FFXIV omits an opponent's Hostile flag. A fallback is accepted only in a known public CC territory with one complete visible five-member local party; self, party/alliance, exact native e1-e5 identity, life, and targetable checks remain mandatory. Plugin-owned exact-target Miracle calls now bypass only macro redirection and still pass through the same final brake, closing the pre-check-to-dispatch protection race. The brake remains stateless and adds no timer, target mutation, alternate action, replay, or retry. Configuration schema 16 is unchanged.
